title: Senior Full-stack (Python)
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Full-stack Python Engineer to join our team and contribute to building scalable, high-performance applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about clean code, system design, and continuous learning, while also mentoring others and collaborating across teams.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, and maintain scalable Python applications .
  • Write clean, efficient, and reusable code following best practices and coding standards.
  • Participate in code reviews , ensuring code quality, maintainability, and team knowledge sharing.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues effectively and in a timely manner.
  • Contribute to the architecture and design of new features and systems.
  • Take full ownership and pride in your work and the overall codebase.
  • Mentor and support other developers, promoting learning and professional growth.
  • Demonstrate a strong track record of mentorship and collaboration across varying experience levels.
  • Maintain awareness of application security, performance, and scalability best practices.
  • Show a strong desire to continuously learn and evolve technical skills.
  • Approach problem-solving with a pragmatic and results-oriented mindset .


Required Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Python , with experience using frameworks such as Flask .
  • Cloud experience , particularly with AWS (Amazon Web Services) .
  • Proven experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.
  • Solid experience with relational and non-relational databases (SQL Server, Snowflake, MongoDB).
  • Strong skills in debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting .
  • Advanced English (mandatory) – strong written and verbal communication skills required for daily collaboration in an international environment.

title: Remote Operations Assistant
description:
Operations Assistant (100% Remote - Latin America)

Location: Remote from Latin America

Position Type: Full-time

Salary: $2,000 USD per month

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM Central Time (flexible)


About the Role

Our client, a fast-growing U.S.-based company, is looking for a highly organized and proactive Operations Assistant to join their remote team. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoys supporting different areas of the business to keep things running smoothly.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a structured environment, enjoys administrative work, and loves helping teams stay organized and efficient.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide administrative and operational support to different departments as needed.
  • Maintain internal databases, spreadsheets, and documentation up to date.
  • Help coordinate meetings, track deadlines, and follow up on pending items.
  • Assist with data entry, reporting, and basic client or vendor coordination.
  • Prepare and organize files, invoices, and other operational documents.
  • Support onboarding/offboarding tasks for team members.
  • Communicate effectively with internal teams to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.


Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience in administrative, operations, or virtual assistant roles.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to multitask.
  • Advanced written and spoken English .
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive) and other basic productivity tools.
  • Positive, proactive, and reliable attitude.


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based teams.


Why You’ll Love This Role

  • 100% remote opportunity.
  • Join a fast-paced, collaborative team.
  • Be part of a company that values growth, trust, and teamwork.
  • Stable, full-time position with opportunities to learn and grow.
  • 15 days PTO

title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.


If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.


About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.


Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.


Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings


Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.


Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.


Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.

  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Supervisor de Lazer
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar os agentes de viagens;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe;
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Garantir um atendimento de excelência aos clientes, presencialmente, por telefone ou online;
  • Resolver conflitos, reclamações e situações complexas de atendimento;
  • Manter um padrão de qualidade nos serviços prestados pela equipe.
  • Supervisionar a montagem de pacotes turísticos, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Apoiar na negociação com fornecedores (companhias aéreas, hotéis, operadoras, etc.);
  • Garantir que as ofertas estejam atualizadas, competitivas e dentro das políticas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar reservas, emissões, alterações e cancelamentos de serviços;
  • Monitorar prazos, documentos e pagamentos junto aos fornecedores;
  • Garantir que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com as normas legais e políticas internas.
  • Colaborar com o setor comercial para alcançar metas de vendas;
  • Sugerir campanhas, promoções e ações para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Analisar relatórios de desempenho e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar metas, produtividade e qualidade do atendimento;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados à direção.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre destinos, tendências do mercado e novidades do setor;
  • Incentivar a equipe a participar de treinamentos, workshops e famtours.
  • Mais as atribuições de vendas, pois o supervisor também vende


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento dos destinos de viagem, geografia.
  • Conhecimento em informática.
  • Ensino médio completo, desejável ensino superior em turismo.
  • Experiência em agência de viagens multimarcas.

title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US. We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India. Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!


This is a large impact role that demands someone who can excel in a fast paced and ever changing environment.


Title: Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager

Location: Brazil, remote

Work Time Zone: PST overlap

Start Date: Immediate


The Infrastructure and Operations Project Manager is a strategic role responsible for the planning, execution, and operational success of the organization's IT Infrastructure initiatives and daily operations. This individual will manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional programs, ensuring they align with strategic business objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. The role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, program management skills, and leadership capabilities to manage both projects and ongoing operational stability. This position is part of the IT Global Infrastructure & Operation team and will be remote.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Program and Project Management: Lead the end-to-end management of multiple, interconnected infrastructure projects (e.g., data center migrations, cloud platform adoption, EUC, IAM, network upgrades, etc) from initiation to closure.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans and roadmaps for the IT infrastructure and operations function, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and future needs.
  • Budget and Financial Management: Develop, monitor, and control program and operational budgets, manage expenditures, and ensure cost-effectiveness of IT investments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and issues impacting program implementation or daily operations, develop comprehensive mitigation strategies, and manage issue resolution processes.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across various departments, providing regular updates on project status, performance metrics, and risks.
  • Process Improvement and Compliance: Drive the adoption of industry best practices (e.g., ITIL, Agile, Waterfall) and ensure compliance with relevant security protocols and regulatory requirements.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in program or project management within an IT infrastructure environment, with a proven track record of successfully managing large-scale, complex initiatives.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of infrastructure technologies including cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP), networking, servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization, and data center operations.
  • Project Management Methodologies: Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project) and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall). PMP or PgMP certification is highly desirable.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication (written and oral), and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with keen attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strategic thinking and the capacity to influence stakeholders at all levels.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • 5%-10% travel as per business requirements.


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Experience in managing geographically dispersed or matrixed teams.
  • Jira, Confluence

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 28 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Desenvolvedor(a) Front-End . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend em projetos complexos;
  • Domínio de React e seu ecossistema, incluindo arquitetura de aplicações e gerenciamento avançado de estado;
  • Proficiência em TypeScript e em padrões de design aplicados ao frontend;
  • Vivência com design e consumo de APIs RESTful e, preferencialmente, GraphQL;
  • Experiência com diferentes estratégias de gerenciamento de estado e seus respectivos trade-offs;
  • Atuação na implementação e manutenção de testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e);
  • Domínio de Git (GitLab) e de fluxos de trabalho avançados como Git Flow e Trunk-Based Development;
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de build como Vite ou Webpack e otimização de bundle;
  • Experiência avançada em React, hooks, Redux e arquitetura frontend;
  • Domínio de Material UI, Axios, Testing Library e Jest.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de micro-frontends;
  • Experiência com plataformas de nuvem como GCP ou Azure;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação de infraestrutura como Terraform ou Ansible;
  • Vivência com PWAs;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de frontend como DataDog RUM, Sentry ou LogRocket;
  • Conhecimento em IndexedDB para persistência local;
  • Vivência com autenticação via oidc-client;
  • Experiência em migração de projetos JavaScript para TypeScript;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em protocolos de autenticação e segurança como OAuth 2.0, OIDC e JWT;
  • Vivência com Design Systems e bibliotecas de componentes;
  • Atuação em projetos de mídia, broadcast ou grandes portais;
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes end-to-end;
  • Experiência em times ágeis e ambientes de alta complexidade;
  • Vivência com integração de sistemas, automação e CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade, performance e seguranç;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Realizar o desenvolvimento técnico de novas funcionalidades e arquiteturas de frontend com React;
  • Definir e disseminar boas práticas de desenvolvimento, qualidade de código, performance e componentização;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores por meio de code reviews, pair programming e feedbacks construtivos;
  • Contribuir para a definição e evolução de padrões de desenvolvimento, testes e deploy;
  • Atuar na integração de APIs complexas e no processamento de fluxos de dados em grande escala;
  • Colaborar com Arquitetos, Tech Leads e Product Owners para criar soluções escaláveis e robustas;
  • Garantir a implementação de testes abrangentes e a automação de pipelines de CI/CD no frontend;
  • Otimizar performance e solucionar problemas complexos nos sistemas;
  • Assegurar alta cobertura de testes automatizados e fomentar uma cultura contínua de qualidade;
  • Desenvolver componentes complexos e reutilizáveis utilizando React, TypeScript e Material UI;
  • Arquitetar e otimizar o gerenciamento de estado com Redux/Redux Toolkit, incluindo criação de middlewares customizados;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código com ESLint, Prettier e TypeScript;
  • Implementar e otimizar comunicação em tempo real com WebSockets;
  • Containerizar aplicações com Docker para ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção.

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

title: Graphic Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️


About Uitify


Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


What we're looking for


We’re looking for a Graphic Designer who’s skilled in UX/UI design, with a sharp eye for layout, consistency, and visual storytelling. If you're someone who can take a creative brief and turn it into sleek, conversion-friendly assets that speak to a SaaS audience — we want to hear from you.

You’ll collaborate with our design and content teams to create assets that live across websites, social, decks, and beyond.


What you'll do


  • Design branded visuals for SaaS startups (one-pagers, pitch decks, social ads, case studies, etc.)
  • Work on presentation design, marketing collateral, and internal brand materials
  • Apply consistent visual systems across different formats and platforms
  • Collaborate with Product Designers, Copywriters, and Founders to translate ideas into clean, strategic visuals
  • Create and refine brand identities when needed (logo, color, typography, etc.)
  • Support UI/Web design tasks with visual assets (icons, illustrations, mockups)
  • Deliver assets quickly, adapt based on feedback, and iterate fast
  • Requirements:Strong portfolio with examples of branding, marketing, and presentation work
  • Proficiency in Canva, Figma, Illustrator, or Photoshop
  • Experience designing for SaaS or B2B audiences
  • Understanding of modern design trends, visual hierarchy, and conversion principles
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines
  • Comfort in fast-paced environments with direct feedback loops
  • Excellent written and spoken English


Nice to have


  • Experience designing websites in Webflow or Framer
  • 5+ years as a graphic designer
  • Animation skills (e.g., Lottie, After Effects)
  • Knowledge of performance design (A/B testing, CRO, etc.)
  • Familiarity with social media platforms and ad formats



Why Join Us?


At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.


How to Apply


If you’re a Graphic Designer with a passion for creating clean and functional designs, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and

title: .NET Fullstack Developer
description:
Position Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain responsive, user-friendly front-end interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js, or React.
  • Design and maintain JavaScript framework applications with separation of concern as a core thought process when using APIs and creating front-end reusable components.
  • Develop secure, scalable, and maintainable back-end services and APIs using .NET Core/IIS and Entity Framework.
  • Understanding of security best practices, including RBAC and token-based auth
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Passion for clean code and scalable architecture.
  • Work with relational (MS-SQL, MySQL or Azure SQL) databases.
  • Design and optimize queries and data models for performance and reliability.
  • Familiarity with temporal/system-versioned tables.
  • Collaborate with team members to design system architecture that supports scalability and maintainability.
  • Integrate front-end and back-end components, as well as third-party APIs and services.


Required Skills:

  • Advanced or Fluent English.
  • Experience as a Full-Stack (or related role).
  • Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Experience with at least one modern front-end language framework (Vue.js)
  • Experience with Vue CLI, Vuex, Vue Router, and optionally Nuxt.js
  • Experience with back-end language (.NET).
  • Strong experience with relational databases.
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
  • Solid understanding of Git and version control workflows.


Preferred/Bonus Skills:

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Design and implementation of microservices for other applications to consume.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Basic understanding of SEO best practices for web applications.
  • Knowledge of server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) (Nuxt.js, Blazor)
  • Experience bundling and optimizing applications builds using Webpack and/or Vite
  • Familiarity with NPM and NVM, and/or switching between version of NodeJS
  • Experience using Blazor for writing client-side and server-side logic using C#.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (Mocha, Jest, Cypress, or Playwright).


Additional information:

  • CLT contract
  • Remote work

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) – C#, Automation, API
description:
Role: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long term

Work Schedule : 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Working Hours : 8 AM - 5 PM CST

Location : 100% Remote


We’re looking for a skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to design and implement test automation frameworks for healthcare applications. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in C#, UI automation (Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress) , API testing , and performance testing , leveraging GenAI tools (GitHub Copilot) to accelerate scripting and data generation.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain automated UI and API test suites using C# .
  • Implement and enhance BDD/TDD frameworks (e.g., SpecFlow).
  • Perform performance and load testing using JMeter, Locust, or k6 .
  • Create and validate test data using SQL and GenAI tools.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and QA teams to integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines .
  • Apply modern testing principles and best practices across projects.


Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience as an SDET or Automation Engineer .
  • Strong in C#, UI automation , and API testing (REST/GraphQL).
  • Proficiency in SQL , BDD/TDD , and test framework design .
  • Experience with GitHub Copilot or other GenAI tools for automation.
  • Familiarity with Azure , OAuth2/OpenID Connect , or healthcare systems is a plus.

title: Analista de Quality Assurance Pleno
description:
Quem somos

A Studio Rx é uma empresa de produção digital global, criada para as necessidades exclusivas das marcas de saúde. Como Hub de produção da IPG Health, a Studio RX apoia a rede global de agências do grupo tendo como pilares principais a qualidade e eficiência.


Sobre a Vaga

Você será responsável por entregar projetos digitais “limpos”, seguindo planos de testes e criando tickets de bugs impecáveis, conforme os protocolos de qualidade global. Também será responsável pela garantia de qualidade com foco na funcionalidade e compatibilidade dos projetos analisados. Os tickets de bugs registrados devem ser escritos do ponto de vista técnico e podem incluir sugestões de correções ou soluções alternativas. Nossos projetos são baseados principalmente em ações de marketing focadas em e-mails marketing e banners que precisam estar em conformidade com os diferentes navegadores, sistemas operacionais e dispositivos, garantindo o correto carregamentos em todos eles.


Responsabilidades

• Garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento tenha sempre a lista de todos as versões de dispositivos, sistemas operacionais e navegadores que serão usados nos testes para garantir uma entrega de qualidade.

• Assumir a propriedade dos projetos de controle de qualidade atribuídos desde o início até à entrega;

• Executar planos eficazes para controle de qualidade, revisão e auditorias, entregando projetos “limpos” e livres de bugs;

• Contribuir para o design e validar a funcionalidade dos conceitos de design;

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com gerentes de projetos e desenvolvedores para garantir a qualidade e a conclusão dos projetos no prazo;

• Desenvolver materiais de boas práticas para que os demais grupos adjacentes à tecnologia realizem suas verificações de qualidade em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do projeto.


Pré-requisitos

• Experiência com campanhas digitais com testes em E-mails e Banners;

• Bacharel em Desenvolvimento de Software, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas;

• Inglês avançado (seu time de contato direto será global);

• Certificação em Doubleclick Banner (desejável);

• Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Analista de Quality Assurance ou UX;

• Conhecimento dos principais navegadores da Internet, capaz de usar Mac e PC, ter conhecimento de plug-ins de navegador como JavaScript, Flash, etc., familiarizado com tablets (Android, iPad) e smartphones;

• Experiência em ambiente de agencia de publicidade, ou similar.


Informações Adicionais:

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Blockchain Engineering Manager (Remote - LATAM)
description:
Blockchain Engineering Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Blockchain Engineering Manager to lead, mentor, and grow a distributed team of software engineers. This role is responsible for driving execution, ensuring technical excellence, and fostering a high-performance culture that delivers reliable, scalable, and high-quality products aligned with Pointsville’s strategic goals.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Lead, coach, and mentor engineers across multiple technical domains.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Support career growth, performance management, and professional development.
  • Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and building a diverse, high-performing team.


Execution and Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from planning and design to deployment and maintenance.
  • Partner with the CTO and Product Manager to translate product roadmaps into engineering execution plans.
  • Manage delivery timelines, resources, and technical dependencies to ensure on-time releases.
  • Proactively identify and remove blockers, ensuring team productivity and alignment.


Performance and Improvement

  • Establish and enforce engineering best practices across code quality, smart contract security, and infrastructure reliability.
  • Ensure scalability, security, and performance in blockchain and microservice-based environments.
  • Drive the adoption of modern DevOps practices (IaC, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, automated testing).
  • Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and DeFi developments to guide innovation and continuous improvement.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of software development experience, including 6+ years in an engineering leadership or management role.
  • Familiarity with blockchains such as Ethereum and other blockchains preferred
  • Familiarity with DeFi trading a plus
  • Software engineering background in frontend and backend services development
  • An understanding of microservice architecture and cloud-based deployments
  • Experience in modern software development practices such as infrastructure as code, test automation, CI/CD and containerization
  • Proven success leading technical teams through the full product lifecycle in Agile or startup environments.
  • Experience with modern programming languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or C#).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to balance technical depth with people management and cross-functional alignment.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Security Operations Center Analyst
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role:


We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive SOC Analyst – Level 2 with a focus on Operational Technology (OT) environments. This role involves handling escalated incidents, collaborating with platform teams, and enhancing threat detection logic across OT systems. The analyst will play a key role in supporting incident response and improving alert fidelity, particularly within platforms such as Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel.


What You’ll Do:

  • Provide incident handling and escalation support for critical alerts, especially from the Nozomi platform.
  • Advise on security issue isolation and recommend remediation strategies.
  • Lead incident response and threat containment activities in OT environments.
  • Collaborate with the Nozomi platform team to fine-tune rules and reduce alert noise in Sentinel.
  • Create and maintain playbooks for automating incident response related to Nozomi alerts.
  • Enhance threat detection logic and perform false positive tuning to improve alert quality.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience in SOC operations, particularly in OT environments.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Nozomi Networks and Microsoft Sentinel platforms.
  • Familiarity with incident response workflows, playbook creation, and alert tuning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work in a 24x7 operational environment and collaborate across teams.
  • Good communication skills and attention to detail.
  • English Advanced (B2/C1)
  • Certified in Microsoft (IT) and Nozomi (OT) (MANDATORY)


UST is waiting for you!

title: Consultor SAP SD (AMS)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value

As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!


Atividades:

  • Realizar o atendimento de chamados do módulo SD dos clientes do AMS da NTT.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos no módulo SD;
  • Localização Brasil;
  • Atuação em suporte (AMS) ou em projetos de implementação, rollout ou melhoria contínua (S/4HANA e/ou ECC);
  • Domínio das funcionalidades e configurações SAP SD;
  • Conhecimento de integração do SAP SD com outros módulos;
  • Experiência em documentação técnica e de processos;
  • Vivência em planejamento e execução de testes;


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos da Reforma Tributária;
  • Possuir Inglês ou Espanhol para conversação;


Regime de Contratação: CLT

Formato de atuação: Remota


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade e molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.

title: Analytics Engineering Senior
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Você fará parte do time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais.

O time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais atua de forma transversal na companhia em projetos de alto potencial de impacto financeiro explorando métodos estatísticos e de aprendizagem de máquina. Estamos em busca de um profissional especialista em Ciência de Dados com experiência comprovada para impulsionar nosso crescimento e inovação através da utilização eficiente e impactante dos dados.


Seu papel:

Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Modelar dados para atender necessidades específicas das áreas de negócio.
  • Construir produtos de dados centrados no usuário (pipelines, indicadores, dashboards).
  • Desenvolver modelos, tabelas e relatórios que representem a "fonte da verdade" (Gold/Diamond - arquitetura medalhão) .
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas plataformas, assegurando a precisão dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Suportar a implantação e utilizar o catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos de dados, garantindo as políticas de governança.
  • Promover o uso estratégico dos dados na resolução de problemas de negócio.


O que esperamos de você:

  • SQL Avançado: Proficiência em SQL, com habilidade para escrever e otimizar consultas complexas.
  • Modelagem e Pipelines: Experiência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT (e.g., Azure Data Factory ou similares).
  • Visão Analítica: Habilidades analíticas e estatísticas, com capacidade de aplicar técnicas para resolver problemas de negócios.
  • Ferramentas: Conhecimento em Python para análise de dados (PySpark é um diferencial) e ferramentas de análise (Metabase, Power BI).
  • Soft Skills: Orientação para resultados , foco em alcançar metas e melhorar os processos de negócios.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Domínio do Databricks para engenharia, análise e ciência de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada com Governança de Dados e aplicação prática do Unity como Catálogo de Dados no Databricks.
  • Experiência prática com modelos de LLM ou aplicação de processamento de linguagem natural.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Você fará parte do time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais.

O time de Ciência de Dados da Juntos Somos Mais atua de forma transversal na companhia em projetos de alto potencial de impacto financeiro explorando métodos estatísticos e de aprendizagem de máquina. Estamos em busca de um profissional especialista em Ciência de Dados com experiência comprovada para impulsionar nosso crescimento e inovação através da utilização eficiente e impactante dos dados.


Seu papel:

Seu dia a dia será assim:

  • Modelar dados para atender necessidades específicas das áreas de negócio.
  • Construir produtos de dados centrados no usuário (pipelines, indicadores, dashboards).
  • Desenvolver modelos, tabelas e relatórios que representem a "fonte da verdade" (Gold/Diamond - arquitetura medalhão) .
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados em múltiplas plataformas, assegurando a precisão dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Suportar a implantação e utilizar o catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos de dados, garantindo as políticas de governança.
  • Promover o uso estratégico dos dados na resolução de problemas de negócio.


O que esperamos de você:

  • SQL Avançado: Proficiência em SQL, com habilidade para escrever e otimizar consultas complexas.
  • Modelagem e Pipelines: Experiência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT (e.g., Azure Data Factory ou similares).
  • Visão Analítica: Habilidades analíticas e estatísticas, com capacidade de aplicar técnicas para resolver problemas de negócios.
  • Ferramentas: Conhecimento em Python para análise de dados (PySpark é um diferencial) e ferramentas de análise (Metabase, Power BI).
  • Soft Skills: Orientação para resultados , foco em alcançar metas e melhorar os processos de negócios.


O que pode te destacar:

  • Domínio do Databricks para engenharia, análise e ciência de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada com Governança de Dados e aplicação prática do Unity como Catálogo de Dados no Databricks.
  • Experiência prática com modelos de LLM ou aplicação de processamento de linguagem natural.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central

title: Profissional de comunicação
description:
Company Description

Sustainable Inclusive Solutions (SIS) is dedicated to fostering a stronger connection between the financial sector and sustainable development across environmental, economic, and social dimensions. Founded in Brazil in 2017, SIS expanded its mission by establishing a new association in 2022. SIS prioritizes transparent, inclusive dialogue and the use of precise data to create impactful and sustainable solutions. Operating both locally and globally, SIS works collaboratively with stakeholders to promote sustainable growth and development through the financial system.


Role Description

This is a contract-based remote role for a Communication Professional. The role involves managing internal and external communications, crafting press releases, developing strategic communication plans, and writing various types of content. The professional will engage in communications planning to effectively represent SIS's mission and objectives.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Communication and Internal Communications to foster effective collaboration and information sharing to support advocacy efforts.
  • Experience in crafting Press Releases and Writing content tailored for various audiences and mediums.
  • Expertise in Strategic Communications to support organizational goals and ensure consistent messaging.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Familiarity with sustainable development and/or financial system and the ability to communicate its principles clearly and effectively is an advantage.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field is a plus.
  • Experience in the nonprofit sector is desirable.

title: Gerente de Vendas Regional
description:
Nosso cliente, uma empresa referência no segmento alimentício, está em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Vendas (multicanais) para BA.


Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar a equipe de vendas na região, garantindo alta performance.
  • Planejar e executar estratégias comerciais para atingir metas de vendas e expansão de mercado.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (sell-in, sell-out, cobertura, positivação, share).
  • Negociar com clientes-chave (distribuidores, atacadistas e redes regionais).
  • Garantir a execução das políticas comerciais, campanhas e ações de trade marketing.
  • Realizar análises de mercado e identificar oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Controlar orçamento regional e assegurar rentabilidade.
  • Reportar resultados e planos de ação à gerência nacional.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de vendas no setor alimentício ou bens de consumo.
  • Vivência com multicanais.
  • Conhecimento do mercado regional (Bahia) e canais de distribuição.
  • Habilidade em negociação, liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success,

title: QA Analyst Junior
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar e manter planos de teste, cobrindo todos os cenários necessários para assegurar a qualidade das funcionalidades desenvolvidas.
  • Documentar e reportar os bugs encontrados, gerando evidências claras e detalhadas.
  • Desenvolver e manter testes automatizados para plataformas Mobile, Web e APIs.
  • Atuar como referência de QA dentro da squad, garantindo que todos os processos de qualidade sejam planejados, executados e mantidos com consistência.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o squad para garantir que os critérios de aceite sejam atendidos.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência sólida com planejamento e execução de testes manuais e automatizados
  • Experiência prática em automação de testes Mobile, Web e REST API utilizando ferramentas como Maestro, Selenium, Appium, ou equivalentes
  • Conhecimentos básicos em SQL.
  • Perfil orientado a dados, com capacidade de analisar métricas de qualidade e priorizar tarefas com base em impacto/risco.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:


  • Tiver experiência com ferramentas de gestão de testes e bugs, como Jira e X-Ray
  • Familiaridade com processos de entrega contínua (CI/CD) e integração de testes automatizados nos pipelines.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de performance testing (como JMeter ou LoadRunner).


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Profissional QA Lead
description:
Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Domínio em automação de testes com Cypress e Robot Framework;
  • Experiência com Git, pipelines de CI/CD e integração de testes em fluxos de entrega;
  • Habilidade de comunicação para lidar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Experiência em liderança de times ou atuação como referência técnica.
  • Vivência com BDD e testes orientados a comportamento;
  • Conhecimentos em performance testing e/ou testes de segurança;
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jira, TestRail, Jenkins, Docker.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Deployment Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Manage continuous delivery and configuration of SAP Ariba Cloud products using modern deployment tools.
  • Respond quickly to deployment requests and provide technical support for the SAP Ariba suite.
  • Collaborate with engineering subject matter experts to ensure seamless operations.
  • Handle user tickets and change requests within defined SLAs.
  • Automate manual tasks to improve scalability and efficiency.
  • Lead complex deployment projects including new site setups and disaster recovery planning.
  • Manage certificate renewals and troubleshoot related issues.
  • Document SOPs and apply ITIL best practices.


Requiriments and Qualifications:


  • Experience in a Unix/Linux environment.
  • Familiar with SAP Ariba Cloud products
  • Proven experience in 24x7 enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with cloud provisioning (preferably GCP and AWS).
  • Proficiency in Terraform and CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Docker, Vault.
  • Development experience in Python, Go, or Groovy.
  • Strong knowledge of system applications (Apache, DNS, SSH, TCP/IP, NFS).
  • Deep understanding of OS internals and file system structures.
  • Experience with certificate management and scripting (Perl, Python, Shell).
  • Basic knowledge of HANA database administration.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and multitasking skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in MIS, CS, or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced English


Please submit resumé in English

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: Arquiteto de soluções - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • JavaScript/TypeScript: para desenvolvimento de plugins e customizações.
  • Go, Quarkus: para desenvolvimento
  • Docker: para empacotamento e deploy de projetos CMS.
  • MySQL, Postgree e MongoDB: para integração com bancos de dados.
  • REST APIs: para consumo e exposição de dados via CMS.
  • Git e Jenkins/GitHub Actions: para versionamento e integração contínua.
  • Arquitetura e infraestrutura de software.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.


Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


Key Responsibilities

  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
O que buscamos:

Como Dev Sr, o seu papel estará focado em desenvolvimento de trabalhos de maior complexidade, além de mentorear os desenvolvedores do time com menos experiência para que se tornem mais capacitados.
